title: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Third Amendment Directions, 2026 - Recovery of Loan Dues
description: <cite index="8-6,8-7">Issued August 6, 2026 and effective January 1, 2027, these Final Guidelines amend the RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies — Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025.</cite> <cite index="8-8">These final guidelines lay out a framework for how a debt is collected from a borrower.</cite> <cite index="11-2,11-3,11-4">Recovery calls are restricted to 08:00-19:00 hours, outside those hours only with express borrower authorization, and eight practices are deemed harsh and prohibited including minatory language, social media posting of borrower details, and intimidating communications.</cite>
